Framework built for meta-agents to supervise, optimize, and train other agents

Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) let an untrusted proved show that computation was executed correctly without revealing the inputs to the verifier.
However to prove anything, the computation first has to be expressed as a circuit: a system of p
